tui.notices.budget_exhausted_continue: the model spent its whole output budget thinking and produced nothing — re-asking it to continue the work

tui.notices.output_limit_before_call: the model hit the output limit before the call ran — nothing was executed; re-asking it to re-issue the call as it is
